info.title: LexFlow API
info.description:
REST API for the LexFlow Legal Platform.

**RBAC:** Pass `role` in the request header to identify the caller.
Accepted values: `client` | `lawyer` | `intern` | `firmadmin` | `superadmin`

role-auth.name: role
role-auth.description: User role for RBAC. Values: client | lawyer | intern | firmadmin | superadmin

firmId.description: Associated firm ID (for FIRMADMIN, LAWYER, INTERN roles)

role.description: Expected role for this sign-in attempt
User role (client, lawyer, intern, firmadmin, superadmin, user)

subtitle.description: Short tagline shown in firm search

adminName.description: Name of the firm admin to create

adminEmail.description: Login email for the firm admin

adminPassword.description: Password for the firm admin (min 6 characters)

role.description: User role (client, lawyer, intern, firmadmin, superadmin, user)

fullName.description: Full name of the primary contact person

email.description: Email address of the primary contact

tier.description: Pricing tier selected during onboarding. Defaults to Starter.

message.example: Firm and admin account created successfully

caseDescription.example: I need advice regarding a property dispute.

clientId.description: Unique identifier of the client booking the consultation

firmId.description: Identifier of the law firm being consulted

caseDescription.description: Brief description of the legal case or issue
caseDescription.example: I need advice regarding a property dispute with my neighbor.

lawyerId.description: Lawyer ID assigned to this consultation (set by firm admin)

avatarClass.description: Avatar color class for UI display

bookedViaWorkflow.description: Whether this consultation was booked via the client search/discovery workflow

lawyerId.description: ID of the lawyer being assigned

notes.description: Additional notes from the firm or lawyer

caseId.description: Case ID the document belongs to

clientId.description: User ID of the client (from GET /billing/clients dropdown)

status.description: Initial status (auto-derived to Overdue if dueDate is past)

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used by the client

subtitle.example: Corporate & Civil Law • New Delhi, Delhi

description.example: Full-service law firm offering expert legal counsel.

bio.example: Sharma & Associates is a leading law firm…

tier.description: Move the firm onto a different plan. Also updates its seat caps.

status.description: Subscription state. A cancelled subscription stops generating monthly charges.

monthlyPrice.description: New monthly price for this tier, in the platform currency

commissionRate.description: Percentage LexFlow keeps from every paid client invoice. Changing this immediately re-values reported commission earnings.

supportEmail.description: Support address shown to firms and clients

maintenanceMode.description: Put the platform into maintenance mode

disableSignup.description: Block new firm and client signups
